compute_3d_box_iou: compute the 3D bounding box IoU and bird's eye view 2D IoU between two sets of 8 corner points
compute_2d_box_iou: compute the 2D axis-aligned bounding box IoU between two boxes given as xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax tuples
generate_3d_box_corners: generate 3D box corner coordinates from box size, heading angle, and center position
clip_polygon: clip a subject polygon against a convex clip polygon using the Sutherland-Hodgman algorithm
compute_convex_hull_intersection: compute the intersection polygon and area between two convex hulls given as lists of 2D vertices
